summary: Frontend-only mobile regression for bilingual scope completed successfully. Verified only tr-TR/en-US language options, TR→EN→TR live switching, settings-back-button→tab-explore navigation path, empty Explore bilingual texts, login/register bilingual texts, legal links in both languages, and language persistence after app reload.

issues: Bottom legal links use very small text/tap area; likely below ideal 44px touch target on mobile.

action_items: Optional UX polish: increase legal link touch target size on Login/Settings for mobile accessibility.
Optional consistency fix: align auth password length copy (login/register placeholder says min 6, while rule text says min 8).
critical_code_review_comments: Core language restriction is correctly implemented: SUPPORTED_LANGS only includes tr-TR and en-US, and Settings renders from that source.
Observed non-localized strings in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx push-permission alert (hardcoded Turkish), which may bypass selected app language in native runtime.
No translation-key/undefined/blank text leakage observed in tested screens; no UK spelling residues found in tested UI state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Latest run validated the exact requested flow, including settings-back-button then tab-explore, and persistence in both directions (EN and TR) after reload.
rca_of_issue: Earlier blocker was selector syntax in automation script and previously unstable Explore tab testID. In this run, corrected selector usage plus fixed runtime testID tab-explore removed the navigation blockage and all target checks completed.
